description: This file declares functions and a class related to shared memory management in a PyTorch library extension for Windows. It includes external dependencies, defines a DLL export/import macro, and declares a specialized allocator class.

classes.name: THManagedMapAllocator
classes.description: A reference-counted memory allocator class for managing shared memory segments with a specific manager handle.

methods.name: libshm_init
methods.description: Initializes the shared memory library with the given manager executable path.

methods.name: makeDataPtr
methods.description: Creates a data pointer for shared memory with specified parameters.

methods.name: fromDataPtr
methods.description: Constructs a THManagedMapAllocator instance from a data pointer.

methods.name: const char * manager_handle() const
methods.description: Returns a fixed string indicating the manager handle, currently 'no_manager'.
